title: GrowthBook platform rows (v2)
description: A big regular-weight intro line, then alternating-free feature rows: a mono eyebrow with a violet line icon, a 56px heading, a short paragraph and a violet button on the left, a large square gradient frame holding a product shot on the right. A hairline rail runs down the left edge with a gradient accent that sticks to the top of the window. Phones stack each row and widen the button.
notes: each row takes its own media; empty, a card-coloured shot placeholder sits on the gradient frame
